title: Reading Signs and Notices
description: What do these everyday signs really mean? Read each one and choose the best meaning.

thumbnail.alt: A wall of colorful street and shop signs

questions.prompt: The sign says: "KEEP OFF THE GRASS". What does it mean?
questions.explanation: "Keep off" means don't go on it.

questions.prompt: The sign says: "NO PARKING 8 AM – 6 PM". What does it mean?

options.text: You can't park here during the day.
You can park here only in the morning.
The parking lot opens at 8 AM.

questions.explanation: Between 8 AM and 6 PM parking isn't allowed.

questions.prompt: The sign says: "WET PAINT". What does it mean?

options.text: Don't touch – the paint isn't dry.

questions.prompt: The sign says: "STAFF ONLY". What does it mean?
questions.explanation: Staff = the people who work there.

questions.prompt: The sign says: "SOLD OUT". What does it mean?

options.text: There are none left to buy.

questions.prompt: A sign on an elevator says: "OUT OF ORDER". What does it mean?
The sign says: "PLEASE WAIT TO BE SEATED". What does it mean?

options.text: Someone will show you to a table.

questions.explanation: In many restaurants, a host takes you to your table.

questions.prompt: The sign says: "BUY ONE, GET ONE FREE". What does it mean?

options.text: You get two for the price of one.
The second one is half price.
